dataset: CCCBDB experimental geometry and dipole subset, 20 neutral singlets
selection_rule: Main Electric dipole moment table, state=1/config=1, total magnitude. Do not substitute vibration-specific or excited-state rows.
geometry_rule: Copy the published Cartesian table verbatim, at its displayed precision; remove only atom-number suffixes. No optimization or reconstruction from rounded internal coordinates.
comparison_note: CCCBDB main-table dipoles mix equilibrium mu_e, vibrational-ground-state mu_0 and unspecified vibrational character. A clamped-nuclei electronic dipole is not automatically the same observable. No vibrational correction is applied.
